laziest_solution_that_works.finding: Employed native platform-standard persistence frameworks directly: Room on Android, SwiftData on iOS.
laziest_solution_that_works.avoided_bloat: Rejected Realm, SQLDelight across native apps, custom SQLite wrappers, or external caching frameworks.

zero_unneeded_abstractions.finding: Created single PersistenceRepository per platform that connects directly to the DAOs/ModelContext without indirection layers (no GenericRepository<T>, no complex UoW abstractions).
zero_unneeded_abstractions.avoided_bloat: No DI framework introduced (no Hilt, no Koin, no Dagger). Android uses thread-safe singleton factory; iOS uses SwiftUI Environment modelContext.

minimal_schema_design.finding: Strict 4-table schema (saved_places, saved_trips, saved_trip_stops, trip_progress) capturing exactly what the UI needs to render without bloating.
minimal_schema_design.avoided_bloat: No raw blob caching, no duplicate canonical place records.

quantitative_claim_calibration.finding: Zero unbenchmarked efficiency claims. Implementation uses standard Room and SwiftData queries directly bound to reactive state.
